newsitem.title: UK: UK court ruling on VAT claims expected 1030 GMT.
newsitem.headline: UK court ruling on VAT claims expected 1030 GMT.

text.p: The British High Court is expected to give its ruling at 1030 GMT on Tuesday on whether Customs & Excise acted illegally when it refused to pay out on claims for repayment of value-added tax (VAT) dating back more than three years.

Since July 18, Customs has withheld payments on such claims. A Customs & Excise spokesman said if it loses, the estimated costs of this and similar cases pending is around 35 million stg. But since the three-year limit is expected to become law in December, Customs said it will be able to claw back any cash it has been forced to pay out. -- Rosemary Bennett +44 171 542 7715
